map.因为角速度 ω 全盘相同（同 rigidity），但线速度 v=ωr 随半径增大: Because the angular velocity ω is the same across the whole disk (same rigidity), while the linear speed v = ωr grows with radius. A point on the outer rim travels a longer circumference in the same time, so its linear speed is higher — which is why centrifugal equipment often has very high rim speeds.
